messages.subject: Space-time interaction and mapping
parts:
Greetings 

I am trying to fit a model that has an interaction between space and time, but I do not know how to declare the interaction in INLA. 

My data has the following:

> dat <- read.csv("Adults.csv",sep = ",",header = T)
> attach(dat)
> head(dat,5)

health_bin distrct11 wave gender
0                  32             1       Female
0                  32             1       Female
0                  27             2       Male
0                  27             2       Female
0                  52             3       Male
1                  52             3       Female
0                  23             4       Female
1                  25             4       Female

  • distrct11 is the region (n = 52) 
  • wave is used as time point (T = 4)
  • health is a binary response
I have fitted this model:

formula1<- health_bin ~ as.factor(wave)+gender+race+geo2001+smokes+exercise+alcohol+f(distrct1,model="besag",graph="sa.graph")+f(distrct2,model="iid",graph="sa.graph")+f(distrct11,wave1,model="iid",group = wave)
mod1 <- inla(formula1,family = "binomial",data = dat,control.compute = list(dic = TRUE,mlik = TRUE, cpo = TRUE),verbose=T)  

But I am not sure if f(distrct11,wave1,model="iid",group = wave) in my code gives the interaction between space and time where by I can have four maps.

mod1$summary.random$district gives me the results of (52*4 rows) but I am not sure if I specified the interaction correct.

Your assistance will be very appreciated.

Thank you

Kind regards 
Banele
